title: Bowditch Revisited: Defining the Optimum Heart Rate Range in Chronic Heart Failure
brief_summary: The investigators are examining the relationship between heart rate and heart contraction in patients with heart failure and pacemakers, aiming to improve quality of life.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* stable CHF
* Cardiac Resynchronisation Therapy (CRT) device for \>3 months,
* able to walk on treadmill

Exclusion Criteria:

* unable to walk on treadmill,
* unstable angina pectoris
* uncontrolled heart rate
* prescribed calcium channel blocker
* significant aortic stenosis
* significant airways disease
